title: Clarté Baguette Bracelet
tagline: Clear light, cut in straight lines.
body: A tennis bracelet of icy clear baguette cut cubic zirconia set crosswise, side by side like the rungs of a ladder, each stone held at its corners by fine gold claws. The line is about 6mm wide and closes with a slim gold fold over clasp, so it lies flat and catches the light from every side. Wear it alone with a white shirt, or beside a fine round line for evening.
tip: Stack it with a fine round tennis bracelet so the two cuts play off each other.
details: Stone: Baguette cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6mm by 3mm, set crosswise
Setting: Each stone held at its corners by fine gold claws, edge to edge
images: on a cream plaster block, the full piece
macro detail: crosswise clear baguettes in fine gold claws

title: Clarté Baguette Bracelet — Silver
tagline: Clear light, cut in straight lines.
body: A tennis bracelet of icy clear baguette cut cubic zirconia set crosswise, side by side like the rungs of a ladder, each stone held at its corners by fine silver tone claws. It comes in two widths: Classic, about 6mm wide, and Slim, about 5mm wide with smaller baguettes. Both close with a slim silver tone fold over clasp, so the line lies flat and catches the light from every side. Wear it alone with a white shirt, or beside a fine round line for evening.
tip: Wear the Classic and the Slim together on one wrist, or stack either with a fine round tennis bracelet.
details: Stone: Baguette cut clear cubic zirconia set crosswise, approximately 6mm by 3mm on Classic and 5mm by 2.5mm on Slim
Setting: Each stone held at its corners by fine silver tone claws, edge to edge

title: Sorbet Rivière Bracelet
tagline: Soft colour, a stone at a time.
body: A fine tennis bracelet of round brilliant cut cubic zirconia of about 3mm in sorbet pastels, baby pink, pale lime and lilac blue, mixed along the line so the colours keep changing. Each stone sits in its own gold four claw cup, linked straight into the next, and a slim fold over clasp keeps the line flat on the wrist. Wear it with white linen in summer, or with a pastel kurta for a day function.
tip: Wear it with white linen and one plain gold ring so the pastels lead.
details: Stone: Round brilliant cut cubic zirconia, approximately 3mm each
Colours: Baby pink, pale lime and lilac blue, mixed along the line
Setting: Individual gold four claw cups linked directly to one another
images: on a cream plaster block, the full piece
macro detail: pastel pink, lime and lilac stones in gold claw cups

title: Emerald Carré Bracelet
body: A tennis bracelet of square princess cut emerald green cubic zirconia of about 4mm, each stone in its own square gold four claw setting and linked edge to edge, so the line reads as one unbroken band of colour. It closes with a slim fold over clasp. The stones are green cubic zirconia rather than emerald. Wear it to a mehendi, or with a crisp white shirt when you want one strong note of colour.
tip: Pair it with a clear line bracelet so the green sits between two rows of light.
details: Stone: Square princess cut emerald green cubic zirconia, approximately 4mm each
Setting: Square gold four claw settings, linked edge to edge
Stone note: Green cubic zirconia, not emerald

title: Rivière Classique Bracelet
body: One continuous line of round brilliant cut clear cubic zirconia of about 3.5mm, each stone held in its own gold four claw cup and linked straight into the next, with nothing to interrupt the row. A slim gold box clasp closes it. It is the tennis bracelet in its plainest and most useful form: wear it every day, or stack it with a watch.
tip: Wear it on the same wrist as a slim watch.
details: Stone: Round brilliant cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 3.5mm each
Setting: Individual gold four claw cups linked directly to one another

title: Midnight Rivière Bracelet
body: A tennis bracelet of round brilliant cut navy blue cubic zirconia of about 4mm, each stone in its own gold four claw cup and linked edge to edge, so the line reads dark and rich against warm gold. A slim fold over clasp closes it. The stones are blue cubic zirconia rather than sapphire. Wear it with black for evening, or with an ivory saree for a festive night.
tip: Wear it with black and one pair of small gold studs.
details: Stone: Round brilliant cut navy blue cubic zirconia, approximately 4mm each
Setting: Individual gold four claw cups linked directly to one another
Stone note: Blue cubic zirconia, not sapphire

title: Aquarelle Rivière Bracelet
tagline: One fine line, in four colours.
body: A fine tennis bracelet of small round brilliant cut cubic zirconia of about 3mm, each stone in its own gold four claw cup and linked straight into the next, closed with a slim fold over clasp. In bright Royal Blue, soft Lavender, rose Pink or clear White. Fine enough for every day, and easy to stack two together.
tip: Wear two colours together on one wrist: Royal Blue with White, or Pink with Lavender.
details: Stone: Round brilliant cut cubic zirconia, approximately 3mm each
Colours: Royal Blue, Lavender, Pink or White
Setting: Individual gold four claw cups linked directly to one another

title: Bougainvillea Vine Bracelet
tagline: A vine in bloom, around the wrist.
body: A slender silver tone vine of curving stems and small pavé leaves, with five flowers along it: two small five petal flowers on each side and one larger six petal flower of about 11mm at the centre, each with a tiny clear cubic zirconia at its heart. In Fuchsia, with a deep ruby red centre flower, Violet, with a soft lilac centre flower, or White, with every flower in clear cubic zirconia. It closes with a fold over clasp. Wear it to a garden lunch or a sangeet.
tip: Wear it alone with a sleeveless blouse so the whole vine shows.
details: Flowers: Four small five petal flowers, approximately 7mm, and one six petal centre flower, approximately 11mm
Stones: Coloured cubic zirconia petals (clear on White), clear cubic zirconia centres, joints and pavé leaves
Colours: Fuchsia with a ruby red centre flower, Violet with a lilac centre flower, or White with clear flowers

title: Lumière Solitaire Bracelet
tagline: One larger light, in a line of ovals.
body: Oval cut clear cubic zirconia of about 5mm by 3mm are set crosswise, each turned so its long axis runs across the row and held at its flanks by slim gold claws. At the centre sits one larger round brilliant stone of about 7mm in its own four claw setting, so the bracelet has a front. A slim gold box clasp closes it. Wear it to a wedding with the solitaire on top of the wrist.
tip: Turn the solitaire to the top of the wrist and wear it alone.
details: Stone: Oval cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 5mm by 3mm, set crosswise
Centre stone: One round brilliant clear cubic zirconia, approximately 7mm, in a four claw setting
Setting: Slim gold claws at the flanks of every stone, linked directly
